g9_required.A: real-time consolidated Tape-C UQDF+UTDF/National NBBO lineage or documented equivalent redistributor
g9_required.B: machine bid+ask+last with independently usable quote/trade timestamps and same-run RTH freshness
g9_required.C: lawful intended automated/non-display permanent-$0 entitlement with no hidden exchange/vendor/per-query fee

official_findings.finding: UTP Plan is the consolidated Tape-C source for Nasdaq-listed securities; UQDF carries consolidated/National BBO and UTDF carries consolidated trades.

Published UTP fee schedule lists real-time non-display own-behalf use at $3,500/month per firm and separate real-time access fees. Therefore a direct UTP automated/non-display permanent-$0 entitlement is not proven and cannot be assumed.

TradeStation API documents default MarketData and ReadAccount scopes and streaming market-data capability; qualified non-professional customers may receive basic NASDAQ Level 1 data without a separate market-data charge. No reviewed official text proves that this retail entitlement grants permanent-$0 automated/non-display UTP usage satisfying G9-C.
Connected Alpaca tooling documents SIP as premium and delayed_sip as 15-minute delayed. Historical SIP remains settlement-only and explicitly NON-G9.

falsification_condition: Reopen only on explicit primary-source proof from a callable provider/broker that the exact API market-data entitlement supplies consolidated Tape-C/NBBO+last-sale with independent quote/trade timestamps and permits this automated/non-display use at permanent $0, followed by same-run scheduler freshness proof.
